name: install-schema
method: Mechanical: Python ast over the module's files and a line scanner over its .cls files, with the file/function assignment of modules.py transcribed from the ontology Scope line (01-install-schema.md:5-15). Coverage: a statement names the entry point or cites its file with an overlapping line range. Name matching is textual; a hit is evidence of mention, not of a correct statement.
